name: Henry Brown
bio: A Representative from South Carolina; born in Bishopville, Lee County, S.C., December 20, 1935; graduated from Berkeley High School, Moncks Corner, S.C., 1953; attended Baptist College (now Charleston Southern University), Charleston, S.C.; attended The Citadel, Charleston, S.C.; South Carolina National Guard, 1953-1962; business executive; member of the South Carolina state general assembly, 1985-2000; member of the Hanahan, S.C., city council, 1996-2000; elected as a Republican to the One Hundred Seventh and to the four succeeding Congresses (January 3, 2001-January 3, 2011); was not a candidate for reelection to the One Hundred Twelfth Congress in 2010.
